subject: Partner Center seller attribution ledger — proposal for weekly mapping cadence
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Chen <michael.chen@contoso.com>, Sara Patel <sara.patel@contoso.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partner Center seller attribution ledger — proposal for weekly mapping cadence

Hi Michael / Sara —

Thanks for the time last week. To make the Contoso co-sell handoffs smoother we want to standardize how Partner Center referrals map to field sellers in our systems andSurface a single "seller attribution ledger" that both teams can consume. The immediate goal: reduce misrouting and double-claims during intake.

High-level proposal (attached: pc_seller_attribution_rules_v1.xlsx + sample output):
- Weekly reconciliation job (Mon EDT) that runs Partner Center inbound ref CSV vs CRM account table.
- Scoring rules (exact match email/tenant > org match > territory override).
- Three output buckets: Confirmed owner, Needs validation (ambiguous), New prospect (no match).
- A lightweight confirmation email template and a 48-hour SLA for seller consent before auto-assigning to Redwood field owner.

Ask: can Contoso confirm which CRM field we should use as canonical owner for mapping (owner_email, ms_azure_owner_id, or salesperson_id)? Also please confirm if you want all ambiguous cases surfaced to your Seller Ops queue or routed to a shared inbox.

If that looks good I propose we run the first reconciliation next Monday and review results with a 30-min sync on Tue.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Partner Sales, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Attachments: pc_seller_attribution_rules_v1.xlsx (Excel), sample-mapping-output-Contoso.csv (CSV)

From: Michael Chen <michael.chen@contoso.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Patel <sara.patel@contoso.com>, Azure Partner Center <partnercenter@microsoft.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner Center seller attribution ledger — proposal for weekly mapping cadence

Kimberly —

Appreciate the clear proposal. Contoso is open to a weekly reconciliation cadence. A few quick clarifications: 
1) CRM canonical field: use owner_email (that maps directly to our seller account table).
2) For ambiguous cases, route to our Seller Ops queue (seller-ops@contoso.com) for now — we can decide later if shared inbox makes sense.
3) Can you include tenantId in the output? It helps us disambiguate multi-tenant orgs.

We can join the Tue sync. I'll loop in our Seller Ops lead if we need granular rule changes.

Thanks — Michael
Michael Chen
Head of Partner GTM, Contoso Cloud
michael.chen@contoso.com
Attachments: none

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner Center seller attribution ledger — proposal for weekly mapping cadence

Nice — adding internal implementation notes and edge cases we'll need to bake into the runbook: 

- Matching precedence: owner_email (exact) -> tenantId (exact) -> account_name fuzzy (trigram) -> territory override (region + ARR band).
- Territories: if Contoso territory tag exists in account metadata prefer that owner (we'll maintain a territory roster in the mapping job).
- Ambiguous flagging: set threshold <= 0.7 confidence for "Needs validation". Include top-3 candidate owners in output.
- Auto-assign policy: after 48 hours, if Contoso hasn't replied, auto-assign to Redwood account owner where we have explicit prior consent. Otherwise mark as "Pending".
- Audit: persist per-mapping decision with reason code for audits (PC_ID, CRM_ID, rule_applied).

I attached a sample CSV (sample-mapping-output-Contoso.csv) with mocked rows to demonstrate confidence scores. We should also add a HubSpot note via API when assignments change (HubSpot deal link included in related_links).

Next steps I propose:
- Kimberly runs first reconciliation next Monday and shares results.
- Vanessa + Aditya implement the job and confirm logging/audit schema.
- Karthik will draft the templated confirmation email for Contoso Seller Ops.

Vanessa
Director, Partner Operations, Redwood Inference
Attachments: sample-mapping-output-Contoso.csv

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Chen <michael.chen@contoso.com>, Sara Patel <sara.patel@contoso.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 16:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner Center seller attribution ledger — proposal for weekly mapping cadence

Great — thanks for the quick confirm, Michael. Action items below: 

1) Contoso: confirm seller-ops@contoso.com will be monitored for ambiguous case notifications.
2) Contoso: confirm owner_email is canonical field (Michael confirmed — noted).
3) Redwood: run first reconciliation on Mon 2027-08-16 and share results by 09:00 EDT on Tue 2027-08-17.
4) Redwood: include tenantId column and top-3 owner candidates in the output CSV.
5) Redwood Ops: implement 48-hour auto-assign policy with audit logs and HubSpot note calls.

If no objections I'll schedule the 30-min review for Tue 2027-08-17 09:30 EDT. Please reply with any conflicts.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to ironing this in the pilot.

Kimberly Park
Senior Partner Sales, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Mobile: (415) 555-0189
Attachments: none
